sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Distribution of Clinical Diagnostic ELISA Assays and Reagents

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa, International Company regime administered by the Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (English common law heritage with codified corporate and AML/CFT statutes; customary land law is irrelevant to offshore corporate matters)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus) - multilateral trade and economic integration treaty
Tax Information Exchange Agreement between Samoa and New Zealand
Tax Information Exchange Agreement between Samoa and Australia
Tax Information Exchange Agreement between Samoa and the United States
Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters (OECD/Council of Europe)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended — Part II, ss. 3–14 (incorporation of international companies); ss. 69–75 (directors and officers); Part X, ss. 101–109 (registered office and registered agent); non-application of the Companies Act 2001 to international companies under s. 189.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form IC-A) together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association and the consent of the licensed registered agent.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None. An International Company may be incorporated with a single share of no par value; no minimum paid-up capital, capitalization, or escrow deposit requirement is imposed by the International Companies Act 1987.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: IT IS RESOLVED FIRST that the allotment and subscription of the Company's authorized shares to the subscribers of the Memorandum of Association, as recorded in the share register, is hereby approved, ratified, and confirmed. RESOLVED SECOND that the office of [Registered Agent], at [address], Apia, Samoa, is adopted as the registered office of the Company, and such agent is appointed to maintain statutory records and accept process on the Company's behalf. RESOLVED THIRD that [Name A], [Name B], and [Name C] be appointed the first Directors, and [Name D] as Secretary-Treasurer, of the Company, any two of whom may sign and execute contracts, bank mandates, letters of credit, and government filings on the Company's behalf until otherwise resolved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request with up to three proposed names in priority order for availability screening. Names must avoid prohibited connotations (e.g., 'Bank', 'Trust', 'Insurance' unless separately licensed) and cannot be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name. Upon approval, pay the reservation fee and obtain a written reservation notice valid for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application (Form IC-NR)
Availability search request for the proposed corporate name
Identity documents of the proposed incorporator or instructing counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If refused, file a written objection and supporting explanation with the Registrar; alternatively reserve the second or third choice name. Appeal an adverse determination to the Registrar and thereafter by judicial review to the Supreme Court of Samoa.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, Execution and Notarization of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Samoa notary public or solicitor, with final filing at the International Companies Registry, MCIL, Apia, Samoa.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in compliance with the International Companies Act 1987, specifying share capital, limitations on liability, registered office clause, and first directors' powers. The incorporator(s) or instructed corporate services provider executes the instruments; signature on the statutory declaration of compliance must be notarized by a Samoa-licensed notary public. Retain original executed instruments for submission with the incorporation application.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association (signed and notarized)
Articles of Association (signed and notarized)
Notarized statutory declaration of compliance with the International Companies Act 1987
Power of attorney appointing the Samoan registered agent (if executed through an agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On requisition by the Registrar, correct the defective clauses, re-execute and re-notarize the instruments within 14 days; failure to cure may lead to rejection, in which case a fresh application with the amended text must be re-submitted with the applicable fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Payment of Statutory Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa (in-person filing or through the licensed registered agent).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge Form IC-A with the signed and notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association, together with the registered agent's consent. Pay the government registration fee (US$100) plus any fast-track processing surcharge. The Registrar examines the instruments for statutory compliance and records the incorporation in the International Companies Register.
required_dossiers: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form IC-A)
Executed and notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent of the proposed registered agent
Proof of payment of the registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the application is queried, submit the Registrar's requested clarifications or supplementary evidence within 14 days; if the Registrar declines incorporation, file a notice of appeal under the International Companies Act and subsequently seek judicial review in the Supreme Court of Samoa.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Registered Office / Registered Agent Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation in the Company's name with the unique IC registry number. Simultaneously, the registered agent's appointment takes effect and the registered office in Samoa becomes the lawful address for service of process and statutory record-keeping. Request certified copies of the certificate as required for bank account opening and trade licensing.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation (issued by the Registrar)
Registered agent consent letter (on file)
Register of members and share ledger opened at the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains an error in name or registry particulars, file a written rectification request with the Registrar; the certificate is corrected and re-issued without additional substantive review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Commencement of Corporate Governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Company; signed minutes retained at the registered office in Samoa.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first meeting of the Board in person or by telephone/videoconference as permitted by the Articles. Adopt the pro-forma First Board Resolution ratifying share subscription, adopting the registered office, and appointing officers. Issue share certificates, open the corporate bank account with the approved signing mandate, and pre-authorize SWIFT wire and TT payment instruction procedures for wholesale IVD transactions.
required_dossiers: Signed minutes of the First Board Resolution
Share certificates and register of members entries
Register of directors and officers
Bank account opening resolution and corporate profile (certificate of incumbency)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the resolution or officer appointment is later discovered to be incomplete, adopt a written consent resolution of the Board ratifying corrective appointments and amend the statutory registers with certified minutes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Registers, Beneficial Ownership Records and Annual Maintenance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent in Samoa, with oversight filings to the International Companies Registry, MCIL.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Maintain at the registered office the register of members, register of directors and officers, register of charges, and the beneficial ownership register as required by the International Companies Act 1987 and Samoa's AML/CFT obligations for international companies. Remit data to the Registrar as prescribed for the annual return and economic substance notification where applicable, and pay the annual international company license fee to preserve good standing.
required_dossiers: Beneficial ownership register with supporting source-of-funds documentation
Certificate of incumbency and registered agent annual statement
Annual return and annual license fee payment record
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late filing attracts penalties; cure by immediate submission of the overdue return with an explanatory letter and payment of penalty. In the event of strike-off for non-compliance, apply for reinstatement within the statutory period with documentary evidence of good standing.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Business Licences Division, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), in conjunction with the National Medicines and Therapeutic Products Regulation Unit, Ministry of Health, for in-vitro diagnostic reagent import and wholesale authorization.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence for the wholesale distribution of clinical diagnostic reagents under the Business Licences Act 1998 (Samoa); supplementary Importer/Wholesaler Permit for In Vitro Diagnostic Reagents issued by the Ministry of Health.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA), Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 — Discretionary Use requiring an Environmental Permit/Registration under Part IV of the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004 for temperature-controlled warehousing and distribution of ready-to-use ELISA reagents. A full EIA Report applies only if the operation expands into on-site reagent manufacturing, formulation, or large-scale storage of hazardous biological material; ordinary wholesale logistics qualify for the registration tier.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero process wastewater discharge and no VOC-emitting production operations permitted without a prior discharge permit under the Marine Pollution Prevention Act 2008. Biological reagent waste must be stored in sealed, labeled containers with temperature logging; expired or damaged ELISA reagents must be disposed of through a licensed biomedical waste contractor under national healthcare waste guidelines, and any spill events reported to PUMA within 24 hours.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA) following inspection of warehouse, cold-storage chambers, electrical installations, and emergency exits; structural load inspection certificate by a Samoan licensed engineer confirming compliance with the Building Code of Samoa; and occupational safety and health clearance from the OSH Division, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour covering workplace hazard assessment, spill-response kit availability, personal protective equipment, and staff training records.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA), Apia; SRA Taxpayer e-Services portal (sra.gov.ws) for income tax and VAGST filing; customs declarations filed through Samoa Customs Division via ASYCUDA World; the Central Bank of Samoa (CBS) administers foreign exchange repatriation requirements.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign owners must engage a licensed Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) registered agent to incorporate the International Company under the International Companies Act 1987. Upon SIFA incorporation, the SRA automatically issues a Tax Identification Number (TIN); no minimum capital, no local residency, and no physical presence in Samoa are required. The IC may apply for a specific exemption certificate and may voluntarily register for VAGST only if it makes taxable supplies in Samoa, subject to SRA Commissioner approval. Standard processing is 1–3 business days after submission by the agent.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — an International Company transacting exclusively with non-residents and deriving no Samoan-source income is exempt from income tax under the International Companies Act 1987, s.193 and the Income Tax Act 2015; territorial scope excludes offshore wholesale distribution of IVD/ELISA diagnostic reagents; VAGST applies only to supplies consumed in Samoa.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Samoa has no US-style 'check-the-box' election. The IC's tax classification is fixed by statute: it is an opaque, tax-exempt Samoa entity. The International Companies Act 1987 permits constitutional contracting-out elections on corporate administrative matters (share transfer restrictions, director quorum, redemption mechanics), which do not alter tax status. Foreign owners may obtain hybrid characterization only through the application of their home-jurisdiction classification rules to the Samoa IC; Samoa imposes no anti-hybrid or CFC look-through rules on the IC for non-residents.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory registration is triggered where taxable supplies exceed WST 100,000 in any 12-month period; voluntary registration below threshold is subject to SRA Commissioner approval; an IC trading offshore with no Samoan taxable supplies has no VAGST registration obligation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, continuous transaction controls, or digital stamping mandate exists. VAGST returns must be filed electronically through SRA e-Services on a monthly or quarterly basis depending on turnover volume; import and export declarations are processed electronically through ASYCUDA World. There is no prescribed e-invoice schema beyond standard commercial documentation, but electronic books and records must be retained for 5 years for audit purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A supply of clinical diagnostic reagents (HS 3822.00) is zero-rated if the goods are physically exported from Samoa to a non-resident within 30 days of supply, the exporter holds an approved Customs Export Declaration, and the sale is invoiced to and settled by a non-resident customer. For offshore-to-offshore trading where the IC purchases from a foreign manufacturer and sells to a foreign buyer without goods entering Samoa, the supply falls entirely outside VAGST scope, achieving an effective 0% outcome without Samoan zero-rating formalities.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Single Administrative Document filed via ASYCUDA World)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export from Samoa within 30 days of supply
Commercial Invoice and Packing List (with HS 3822.00 classification, batch/lot references, and ISIC 4649 description)
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) issued by a licensed Samoa commercial bank evidencing repatriation of export sales proceeds
Certificate of Origin (Form E or applicable preferential certificate) where tariff preference is claimed in the destination market
IVD conformity documentation for the ELISA diagnostic reagents (e.g., EU CE-IVD certificate or ISO 13485 certificate) to substantiate the bona fide commercial transaction
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Under the Tax Administration Act 2012, reckless or fraudulent export zero-rating claims trigger penalty tax of 150% of the tax shortfall, monthly late-payment penalties, and retrospective clawback of all VAGST input credits, with a 5-year audit window. Criminal prosecution under the VAGST Act 1992 for false declarations carries fines up to WST 50,000 and/or imprisonment up to 3 years. Failure to repatriate export proceeds within 180 days breaches the Exchange Control Regulations administered by the Central Bank of Samoa and attracts separate monetary penalties, exchange-control sanctions, and potential revocation of the IC's exchange-control authorization.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS) — Falefa, Apia, Samoa (under the Central Bank Act 1984, Exchange Control Act 1971 and Exchange Control Regulations 1981)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Samoa maintains a dual-system exchange control regime. The Samoa tālā (WST) is convertible for genuine current-account transactions (trade in goods and services, dividends, interest, royalties) through licensed authorized dealers, subject to documentary verification and anti-money-laundering compliance. Capital-account transactions, including equity injections, inter-company loans and portfolio investments, require specific CBS approval unless conducted through an exempt International Company. For a tax-exempt International Company under the International Companies Act 2012, profit remittance is generally unrestricted if the underlying funds originate from offshore trading and are not sourced from onshore Samoa revenue. Residual hurdles include the need for audited financial statements, beneficial-ownership declarations, and Central Bank statistics reporting via authorized banks. The practical convertibility of WST is thin because Samoa is a small-dollar economy; the effective operating currency for the IVD reagents distribution business should be USD, held in offshore clearing accounts to avoid WST liquidity friction.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The CBS Exchange Control Regulations require resident exporters to repatriate all export proceeds to Samoa through an authorized dealer within 30 days of receipt and to surrender 100% of such proceeds into a WST account unless a specific exemption is granted. Non-resident International Companies that do not carry on business within Samoa and whose export goods are never landed in Samoa are generally exempt from the mandatory surrender requirement, provided they maintain full documentary trails proving onward shipment from third-country manufacturers to overseas buyers. Any temporary holding of export proceeds in a Samoa domestic bank account attracts the surrender rule; therefore, the recommended structure is to route export receipts through an offshore USD settlement account and only bring WST into Samoa for statutory license fees, professional fees and minimal operational expenses.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (Samoa) Limited (BSP Samoa)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. Samoa does not maintain a fintech electronic-money-institution (EMI) or crypto-asset licensing framework, and the CBS prohibits non-bank entities from holding client funds for payment processing. Offshore digital EMIs, payment facilitation platforms and virtual-asset service providers face legal inability to obtain a Samoan banking relationship or an authorized-dealer license. Even for cross-border USD settlement, an offshore EMI cannot be used as the primary clearing backbone for a Samoan International Company if the company is required to demonstrate a physically licensed Samoan bank account for regulatory reporting and substance evidence. The only viable use is a non-core, secondary payment gateway for receiving select customer card payments, provided funds are swept daily into a licensed bank account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a Samoan International Company, physical presence is required for the natural-person directors, shareholders and any signatories when applying for a local corporate bank account with ANZ Samoa, BSP Samoa or Samoa Commercial Bank. Remote account opening is not generally permitted under CBS AML/CFT regulations; each signatory must appear in person at a branch to complete the initial KYC interview and produce original identification documents. In exceptional cases, the bank may accept remote notarized copies and a video call for the fourth signatory or for a foreign associate director, but the core board majority must be physically present. There is no regulatory framework for fully digital onboarding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International Company with zero employees, no office in Samoa, and no physical substance (classic shell-company red flag)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of International Company Incorporation Certificate; foreign registration with current certificates of good standing; executed board resolutions appointing a Samoan resident agent; detailed corporate register of directors and shareholders; audited or reviewed financial statements of the beneficial owners; notarized lease agreement or service agreement for a Samoan virtual office; group structure diagram showing the Samoan IC as a pure distribution vehicle within a multinational IVD group.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial owners or directors listed on sanctions/PEP/negative-news databases, or citizenship in a FATF-listed high-risk jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: International passport copies and proof of residential address for each 10%+ beneficial owner; sworn source-of-funds and source-of-wealth statement with reliable independent documentary evidence (bank statements, asset portfolio valuations, inheritance documents, stock-sale contracts); negative-news search report from a reputable third-party screening provider; PEP status declaration and rational explanation where applicable; a legal opinion from licensed counsel confirming no sanctions nexus.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk business activity perceived as dual-use or requiring medical licensing (clinical diagnostic ELISA reagents)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid import/export license from Samoa Ministry of Customs and Revenue; Samoa Ministry of Health importation certificate for medical devices/reagents (if any); ISO 13485 and CE/FDA certification for each reagent line; distributor agreements with the end manufacturers; end-user declarations and health-facility procurement orders; full product list with tariff and WHO medical classification codes; quarantine and environmental health permits for the relevant shipment jurisdictions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained transaction patterns: invoice payments routed to third-party payees, high-value payments to intermediate holding companies, or rapid in-and-out flows
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete commercial files for the 10 most material contracts; original purchase orders and pro-forma invoices from end customers; corresponding supplier invoices, air waybills, bill-of-lading documents, customs entries and insurance certificates; real-time transaction narrative in the account-opening questionnaire; undertaking to submit quarterly management accounts; an independent CPA-prepared treasury review of expected annual turnover; evidence that no funds flow to restricted persons or sanctioned entities.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The compliant inbound routing for an equity injection to the Samoan International Company is a SWIFT MT103 or MT202 wire from the parent company or shareholder to the IC's USD operational account, referencing the company registration number and the purpose code 'G.I.2 Equity Capital Contribution' under the CBS balance-of-payments classification. The remittance advice must include the IC's legal name, bank account number, and the beneficiary bank's SWIFT code. Verification evidence must include the executed share-subscription agreement, board resolution approving the capital injection, source-of-funds letter from the injecting shareholder, and the IC's updated register of members. The corresponding bank must receive a copy of the CBS exchange-control approval or, for an exempt International Company, a legal cover letter confirming the exemption from CBS capital-control approval. If the capital injection is for working capital to pay third-party reagent suppliers, it should additionally be supported by the underlying supplier contract to prevent the transaction being blocked by the receiving bank as a suspicious structured payment.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The primary outbound clearing rail for trade settlements is SWIFT MT103 direct telegraphic transfer from the Samoan IC's USD account at ANZ/BSP to supplier accounts globally, using purpose code 'G.1.1.1 Imports of Goods' for reagent purchases and 'G.2.1.1 Business Services' for logistics and insurance. For high-value or transaction-intensive trade to customers in the Asia-Pacific region, the preferential rail is a commercial documentary credit opened by a top-tier Asian correspondent bank (e.g., a Chinese or Singapore bank) against the IC's purchase order, with the LC denominated in USD, sight or 30-day terms, and full set of shipping documents. The Samoan IC may also use the Samoa-based bank as advising bank for an outward LC issued by its own account, but the smoothness of settlement materially improves if the IC maintains a sub-limit or cash-collateral pledged account with the issuing correspondent bank. Real-time gross settlement within Samoa is not available for USD; instead USD clearing is executed over the New York CHIPS/Fedwire network via the correspondent bank chain, while WST settlement, if ever required, is handled through the Central Bank of Samoa's interbank settlement system.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright USD/WST forward contracts with a licensed authorized dealer, limited to the settlement of onshore operating expenses in Samoa
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing WST for offshore entities that do not hold WST cash flows
Cross-currency swaps between USD, EUR and NZD for matching multi-currency supplier receivables/payables, subject to CBS counterparty and tenor guidelines
Plain-vanilla FX options (call/put) on USD/WST for protecting rare repatriation events, excluding complex structured products

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour - International Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 December each calendar year; invoiced by registered agent in November
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late penalty after 31 December; continued non-payment for 3 months triggers administrative strike-off and forfeiture of assets.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the anniversary of the company's date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of USD 20 per occurrence; persistent default may lead to strike-off or reinstatement costs.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At the time of annual license renewal (before 31 December)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate or overdue confirmation may be treated as non-compliant with AML/CFT obligations, resulting in fines up to WST 100,000 and agent deregistration warnings.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit required for Samoa International Company unless the shareholders' resolution mandates it or the company holds assets in Samoa. Audit is generally not required for wholly non-resident-owned wholesale distribution holding operations.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Company must maintain accounting records sufficient to reflect true financial position; no prescribed accounting standard applies for exempted international companies. If voluntarily audited, records should comply with IFRS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No separate annual UBO filing. An updated beneficial ownership register must be maintained at the registered office; changes in shareholding, beneficial ownership, directors, and registered address must be lodged with the International Companies Registry within 14 days of any change.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 - USD 3,000 if voluntary audit is requested; no statutory audit is mandatory

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act 1987 is exempt from Samoan income tax, capital gains tax and stamp duty on all globally sourced income, including wholesale distribution of laboratory diagnostic reagents.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Not applicable for income tax purposes. Annual compliance is effected through the Registrar of International and Foreign Companies portal by filing the IC annual return and paying the annual licence fee under the International Companies Act 1987.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return and licence fee are due before the anniversary of incorporation. No income tax return must be lodged by the IC unless it improperly carries on business with Samoan residents or derives Samoan-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: N/A - no income tax return prescribed
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The registered agent must confirm the registered office, directors, shareholders and company secretary, and certify that no commercial activity has been conducted in Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders are not required to disclose substantive details in the public register; the Samoan resident registered agent files the annual declaration and pays the licence fee electronically on behalf of the International Company.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing and late payment attract penalties under the International Companies Act 1987, including incremental fees and potential strike-off of the International Company from the register.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No treaty relief procedure is required for IC distributions because Samoa imposes no dividend withholding tax on non-resident shareholders. If a Samoa double tax arrangement were invoked, the recipient would need to provide a valid Tax Residency Certificate and Samoan Taxpayer Identification Number through the Ministry of Revenue before payment of the dividend to secure any available reduction or exemption.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax is 0% for royalties and interest paid by a tax-exempt International Company to non-residents. Treaty rates are not applicable in the absence of an operative Samoa comprehensive double tax agreement.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No mandatory transfer pricing documentation threshold applies to a tax-exempt International Company. Prudent contemporaneous documentation benchmark: prepare a Local File when annual related-party cross-border transactions exceed WST 1,000,000, and a Master File when consolidated group revenue exceeds WST 10,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance Regulations apply only where the International Company engages in a geographically mobile relevant activity, such as intellectual property holding, banking, financing, insurance, fund management, or headquarters operations. Wholesale distribution of laboratory diagnostic reagents is a non-mobile trading activity; sufficient substance is evidenced by a Samoa registered office, a resident registered agent, genuinely conducted management and decision-making, and contracts and invoicing for customer and supplier logistics.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Concealing Samoan-source trading or agency profits behind the International Company while the entity in substance carries on business in Samoa through a dependent agent or permanent establishment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Back assessment of all undeclared tax, late payment penalties of up to 25%, daily interest accrual, and criminal fines for deliberate tax evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly assist the evasion may be made personally liable for restitution; travel bans and imprisonment of up to 7 years are available under Samoan tax statutes.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell company / lack of economic substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining no employees, no physical office or operating infrastructure while using the Samoan registered agent solely to mask the true beneficial owner and the real location of the distribution business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Registrar may strike the International Company off the register; banks may close accounts under know-your-client rules; the Samoan tax authority may re-characterise the transactions as performed by the underlying principal.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors face civil liability, director disqualification and professional indemnity exposure if they permit the company to operate as a sham; the corporate veil may be pierced to impose restitution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using invoice pay-away instructions, third-party payment rails, or layered wire transfers to conceal the true origin or destination of funds from IVD reagent sales involving sanctioned countries or persons.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties under the Samoan Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Act 2019, including asset freezing, confiscation, and mandatory reporting to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and registered agents may be personally fined, have their registration cancelled, and face imprisonment for money laundering or financing of unauthorized parties; corporate incorporation does not insulate personnel.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Recording arm's-length intercompany pricing for reagent supplies without maintaining pricing methodology, financial analysis, or substance evidence in response to an audit request.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority may make a discretionary transfer pricing adjustment, impose underpayment interest, and apply documentation penalties of up to 40% of the adjusted tax amount.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors signing false transfer pricing declarations or knowingly approving mispriced intercompany invoices may incur civil recovery, fraudulent trading liability, and personal director disqualification.
